description: This is a Go source file defining a client library for the host orchestrator service in an Android Cuttlefish environment. It includes interface definitions, data structures, and methods for managing CVDs, establishing WebRTC connections, WebSocket ADB connections, and handling various device operations.

classes.name: ApiCallError
classes.description: Represents an error response from an API call, including error code, message, and optional details.

classes.name: ConnectWebRTCOpts
classes.description: Options for WebRTC connection setup, including local ICE configuration.

classes.name: BuildAPICreds
classes.description: Interface for applying credentials to HTTP requests.

classes.name: AccessTokenBuildAPICreds
classes.description: Credentials structure containing access token and user project ID.

classes.name: HostOrchestratorService
classes.description: Interface defining methods to interact with the host orchestrator, such as managing CVDs, creating bug reports, and establishing connections.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ApiCallError, including code, message, and details if available.

methods.name: ApplyToHTTPRequest
methods.description: Adds authorization headers to an HTTP request based on stored credentials.

methods.name: ConnectWebRTC
methods.description: Establishes a WebRTC connection to a device using the host orchestrator service.

methods.name: ConnectADBWebSocket
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket connection to the ADB endpoint of a device.

methods.name: CreateCVD
methods.description: Creates a new CVD (Android virtual device) through the host orchestrator, returning the creation response.

methods.name: ListCVDs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently running CVD devices.

methods.name: Powerwash
methods.description: Performs a powerwash (factory reset) on a specified device.

methods.name: Powerbtn
methods.description: Simulates pressing the power button on a device.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a specified device with given start request parameters.

methods.name: CreateSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the specified device.

methods.name: CreateUploadDir
methods.description: Creates a directory for uploading user artifacts.

methods.name: UploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file to the specified upload directory.

methods.name: UploadFileWithOptions
methods.description: Uploads a file with specific upload options such as chunk size and concurrency.

methods.name: ExtractFile
methods.description: Extracts a compressed file from the user artifacts directory.

methods.name: CreateBugReport
methods.description: Creates a bug report for a device group, optionally including ADB bug report, and writes it to the provided writer.

methods.name: WaitForOperation
methods.description: Polls for the completion of an asynchronous operation by name.
